_comment: Local development only, and committed on purpose: these are not secrets,
they are placeholders that let `dotnet run` work on a fresh clone.
Production reads the same keys from environment variables, which outrank
this file, so nothing here can leak into a deployment. Generate real ones
There is no appsettings.Production.json and there should never be. A
signing key in a file is a signing key in the repository, in every image
built from it, and in every backup of both.
